name: open-code-review
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：open-code-review。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Performs AI-powered code review on Git changes using the `ocr` CLI from alibaba/open-code-review. Use when the user asks to review code, review a pull request, review staged/unstaged changes, review a commit, or compare branches for code quality issues.
